Aliens: Fireteam Elite

A shooter that suffers from plenty of issues. This is a very... tentative recommendation, but most people will want to avoid it. While the gameplay and visuals are pretty good, and the game is fairly optimized, it's definitely the sort of game where you really should just turn your brain off and click on the enemy, because it doesn't offer anything more than that.

The Alien franchise has suffered endlessly through really poor adaptations of its material. Fireteam Elite is like that. While, yes; in Aliens, the marines were all very gung-ho and OORAH-types, there was still plenty of suspense. Fireteam Elite has no suspense whatsoever. It's a very, very scripted and same-y game.

Here's what I mean. Every map is essentially one really long corridor where you've got occasional chambers for the sake of combat, and they often don't even try to hide the corridor- you'll literally be walking down a hallway for atleast a good portion of the game, then enter a big chamber from where the big fights happen, then continue on There is no 'clever' gameplay. You can't use your motion sensor and go "HM, THERE ARE A LOT OF ENEMIES IN THE ROOM AHEAD, PERHAPS WE SHOULD LOOK FOR A WAY AROUND IT." You just can't. You will walk forward, then into the combat chamber. Do a little combat, then continue onward into a new hallway. There are no side paths aside from occasional little side rooms where the level will randomly hide a secret item for you to grab. But that's it.

Like I said, if you just want a game where you can mow down thousands of spooky creatures with some pretty graphics and interesting guns, by all means! But if you're expecting a gripping story, or horror elements with enemies that'll crawl around and try to jumpscare you, or cool and interesting characters- you're not getting that. Even the character progression honestly isn't all that great.

The writing is weak. The characters are weak. The game takes you to plenty of interesting places that look cool- but they're all horrifically bogged down by the fact that the game isn't anything more than a run-and-gun shooter. You will kill the thousands of xenomorphs. You will walk forward. You will occasionally fight synths. You will walk forward again. There is no horror, there is no clever writing, there are no interesting or memorable characters, and the progression can be a mixed bag.

honestly, a meh game. basically a WWZ remake if instead of zombies its aliens. 
i really wanna like this game but im going to have to go with a no
